description: This file defines the TemplateCurrency class, a PHP class extending TemplateRange, used within the SuiteCRM project to manage currency field templates in dynamic field configurations. It includes methods for saving, deleting, and retrieving database field definitions related to currency data types.

classes.name: TemplateCurrency
classes.description: A class representing a currency field template, extending TemplateRange, with properties for size, length, precision, and type, and methods to handle deletion, saving, and database field definition retrieval related to currency data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the currency field template and associated currency ID template from dynamic fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the currency template, including setting default values and ensuring associated currency ID template is also saved.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the database field definition array, including precision details.

methods.name: get_db_type
methods.description: Constructs and returns the database column type string based on precision and length.
